title: Four Exponentials Conjecture
exact_target: Must a two-by-two array of exponentials contain a transcendental value when its two row parameters and its two column parameters are each rationally independent?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1513 (NUM-019). CC BY 4.0.
Michel Waldschmidt, \emph{Open Diophantine Problems}, arXiv:math/0312440v2 (2004), Section 3.1, Conjecture 3.7 (Four Exponentials Conjecture).
